name: Shubham Kumbhalkar
heroSummary: I build systems that scale to millions of users, reduce costs, and just work. Currently at Amazon, turning complex problems into reliable, production-ready solutions.
about: Dynamic Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience delivering scalable, high-impact solutions across fintech, e-commerce, and cloud infrastructure. Currently at Amazon, architecting systems that process hundreds of thousands of requests per second across distributed microservices.

I own end-to-end projects - from designing multi-unit ordering solutions that cut merchant costs by 40%, to migrating Tier-1 services with zero downtime. I'm passionate about leveraging technology to deliver measurable business value, mentoring engineers, and building high-performing teams.

My approach combines deep backend expertise in Java, Python, and Rust with cloud-native AWS infrastructure (CDK, Lambda, EKS) and a relentless focus on reliability, security, and operational excellence.
metaDescription: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years building scalable distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, and high-throughput services.
alumniOf: St. Vincent Pallotti College of Engineering and Technology
